title: Open the Front Desk
description:
Northline is launching **Guestbook** on the lobby kiosks. Your namespace on the shared cluster is already set up — work only there (not in `default`).

Before Services or Deployments, the floor needs one frontend Pod: **`front-desk`**.

Reference: [Pods](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/)

## Pod spec (required)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Name | `front-desk` |
| Namespace | **yours** (not `default`) |
| Labels | `app=guestbook`, `tier=frontend` |
| Container name | `front-desk` (or any single container) |
| Image | `nginx:1.25` (any tag is fine if the name contains `nginx`) |
| Container port | **`80`** (declare it — nginx’s default HTTP port) |
| Phase | **Running** |

Port **80** is required in the Pod spec (`containerPort: 80` / `kubectl run --port=80`). Do not leave ports unspecified and assume the grade will infer them.

**Meant for:** Namespaces, creating a Pod, labels, containerPort.

hints: Your namespace is in the lab chrome and in $LEARNER_NS — kubectl already defaults there.
Or apply a Pod YAML with containers[].ports[].containerPort: 80
Wait until front-desk is Running, then Submit.
problemStatement.brief: Create pod front-desk in your namespace: labels app=guestbook + tier=frontend, image nginx, containerPort 80, Running.
problemStatement.solution:
Stay in your lab namespace (already the kubectl default). Create Pod `front-desk` with the Guestbook frontend labels, an nginx image, and **containerPort 80** declared.

Docs: [Pods](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/)

### Imperative

```bash
kubectl run front-desk --image=nginx:1.25 --port=80 -l app=guestbook,tier=frontend
kubectl get pod front-desk
```

Wait until `STATUS` is `Running`, then **Submit**.

### Declarative

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: front-desk
  labels:
    app: guestbook
    tier: frontend
spec:
  containers:
    - name: front-desk
      image: nginx:1.25
      ports:
        - containerPort: 80
```

```bash
kubectl apply -f front-desk.yaml
kubectl get pod front-desk -w
```

Do not create the Pod in `default`.
